status: prospective optimization repair; no round7b model trained
hypothesis: Adding regularized value-specific coefficients for all 54 categorical value_digits inputs may improve the existing additive GLM beyond marginal target encodings and nominal one-hot coefficients.

idea_source.use: Concept only. No third-party source, predictions, fitted coefficients or vocabulary was copied. The existing FraudLab pipeline is extended independently.
idea_source.difference: Retain FraudLab value_digits, smoothing50, C0.3 and inner5; do not adopt the source notebook's train-plus-test vocabulary, splines, C0.01, stacking or other features.

validation.note: Exploratory full-data CV uses all labels; OOF used for selection is not an independent final assessment. Historical holdout is not reopened.
validation.fold_local: Numeric imputation/scaling, one-hot categories and rare counts fit only outer training rows; supervised target logits are cross-fitted in 5 inner partitions of each outer training fold, then standardized using training-only statistics.
validation.model_seeds: 42 + outer fold, matching the existing experiment runner
validation.test_prediction: Probability average of five outer-fold GLM checkpoints; no full-data refit in this round.

encoding.scope: All 54 categorical value_digits inputs, replacing the nominal-only one-hot block. The original 24 numeric and 54 target-logit blocks remain.
encoding.rare_values: Values with count < 5 within an outer training fold share that feature's infrequent column. No global or test counts are used.
encoding.unknown_values: All-zero OHE block for the unseen feature; target encoding falls back to the outer training prior.
encoding.column_transformer: sparse_threshold=1.0; mixed numeric/TE/OHE design is CSR float64 for this audited nonconstant dataset.
encoding.solver_reason: The new sparse design makes a dense matrix and a newton-cholesky Hessian impractical. This solver change is a computational requirement of the same predeclared hypothesis, not a solver sweep.
encoding.convergence: Record actual solver, tol, max_iter, n_iter and converged for every successful fit. Reemit every captured ConvergenceWarning, then fail before checkpoint/predictions if a warning occurred or iterations_used reaches max_iter. No warning suppression or automatic retry/tuning.

unlabelled_dimension_audit.scope: Existing audit read unlabelled training features and existing fold IDs only, without test features, target or predictions. This preparation did not rerun that audit.
unlabelled_dimension_audit.limits: CSR figure bounds design storage only; pandas strings, temporary arrays and solver workspaces add RAM. Runtime, peak RSS and real convergence are not measured.

gate.preconditions: Five converged candidate fits; finite valid probabilities; same data hashes, IDs, row order, labels and outer fold assignments as the baseline and fixed blend components.
gate.comparison: The one fixed blend versus explore5-public25 on identical rows/folds. Candidate standalone AUC is descriptive only.
gate.on_failure: Record null/invalid result and do not submit. No seed search, C search, min_frequency search, alternative blends or leaderboard-driven selection.
gate.on_success: Eligible for at most one submission by root under the existing authorization; no submission is made by this preparation.

scope_and_cost: One sequential CPU run of five outer GLM fits, four threads. No pair features, frequency features, splines, BPE, GPU model, grid or platform expansion.
training_gate: Root integrates and reviews this patch, freezes tested sources and the prospective plan, then explicitly authorizes the competition fit. Preparation permits toy fits only.
proposed_argv_after_freeze_only: Prospective round7b optimization-budget repair: max_iter2000 only, same C0.3/tol1e-7/features/fixed CV5/42 and mixture gate; no independent holdout or public-feedback tuning.
repair_reason: The first convex fit exhausted 500 L-BFGS iterations before producing any checkpoint or predictions. Increase only the optimization budget to 2000. Keep the statistical model, C0.3, tolerance1e-7, features, splits, weights and promotion gate unchanged. No AUC or leaderboard feedback from the failed fit exists.
